name: go_to_screen
description: Navigate to a screen of the app. Use this before pointing at anything on that screen. Going to the screen that is already open is a no-op success.

screen.description: projects = project list; boards = the switchboards of the demo project; pricing = markup and totals.

name: point_at
description: Scroll to and highlight an element on the current screen with the cursor hovering over it, without clicking. Fails if the target is not on the current screen.

name: set_markup
description: On the Pricing screen: type a new markup percentage; totals recompute live. Navigate to pricing first.

name: reset_demo
description: Put the demo data back to its initial state and return to the project list.
